existing_report_pr.role: Separate QA evidence report, not a fixing PR

fixing_pr_status: Not created; publication requires explicit user approval under supplied team instructions

findings.title: Accepted sub-credit tool prices produce unverifiable quotes and receipts
findings.behavior_correction: Reject unsupported precision before signing/pricing and preserve exact stored credit amounts.

findings.title: New client request keys can reuse one human approval to mint additional permits
findings.behavior_correction: Bind the provider approval identity to the logical local request; a new client key cannot reuse one approval to mint another permit.

findings.title: Permit-request approval can cross its local deadline while polling and still mint
findings.behavior_correction: Recheck approval expiry through polling and transaction contention; roll back mint claims crossing the deadline.

findings.title: Startup schema verification misses every required single-action column
findings.behavior_correction: Startup validates all required action-binding columns rather than only table presence.

findings.title: Concurrent Stripe top-ups lose settled credits on SQLite
findings.behavior_correction: Apply settled Stripe top-up credits atomically so concurrent SQLite updates do not lose credits.

findings.title: Concurrent Stripe cumulative refunds double-claw back on SQLite
findings.behavior_correction: Serialize cumulative Stripe refund deltas and apply each newly observed amount once.

findings.title: PostgreSQL migration 038 cannot recover after concurrent-index interruption
findings.behavior_correction: Recover interrupted PostgreSQL concurrent-index construction safely on migration 038 retry.

findings.title: Zero-price tools receive signed quotes but cannot execute
findings.behavior_correction: Refuse unsupported zero-price governed quotes before issuing an unusable signed quote.

findings.title: Terminal billing-policy denial leaves its idempotency key in progress
findings.behavior_correction: Complete/release keyed terminal billing denial correctly instead of leaving the key in progress.

findings.title: Keyed billing charge for unknown wallet returns500 instead of404
findings.behavior_correction: Preserve the unknown-wallet 404 at the keyed billing boundary instead of converting it to 500.

findings.title: Ledger period exact totals are calculated from binary floats
findings.behavior_correction: Calculate exact ledger period totals with decimal arithmetic rather than binary floats.

findings.title: Wallet-scoped credentials can read global profitability and other tenants' ledger details
findings.behavior_correction: Require administrator authority for global profitability and cross-tenant ledger detail.

findings.title: Profitability report labels all-history totals as a one-day period
findings.behavior_correction: Restrict profitability rows and totals to the stated report interval.

findings.title: Receiptless x402 crash recovery consumes permit budget twice
findings.behavior_correction: Retain ambiguous receiptless x402 owners and reservations for review; recovery cannot consume authority twice.

findings.title: Failed x402 compensation releases the accepted request owner
findings.behavior_correction: Retain x402 request ownership when settlement compensation is uncertain or incomplete; do not release authority for another retry.

findings.title: Release exact issuance ownership after a proven pre-persistence rejection
findings.behavior_correction: Release only the exact issuance owner after an explicit proven pre-signing/pre-persistence rejection; retain ambiguous post-mint ownership.

findings.title: Reuse the preparation transaction for action signature verification
findings.behavior_correction: Reuse the action preparation transaction for signature verification rather than acquiring a second pooled connection.

findings.title: Retry local call-counter contention instead of caching false budget denial
findings.behavior_correction: Distinguish optimistic local permit counter contention from genuine authority/budget denial and retry before debit/effect.

findings.title: Failure Lab negative-control CI promotes judge crashes to success
findings.behavior_correction: Require valid completed observed-duplicate evidence for the CI negative control; a judge crash cannot count as success.

findings.title: Downloaded Failure Lab ZIP omits keys needed by its offline verifier
findings.behavior_correction: Include receipt public keys in integrity-covered offline archives so extracted bundles can be signature-checked.

findings.title: Live release preflight certifies missing posture fields as safe
findings.behavior_correction: Require explicit safe public posture fields; missing/malformed nested evidence fails live preflight.

findings.title: Database-only preflight silently drops explicit release identity expectations
findings.behavior_correction: Refuse DB-only selections that would silently discard requested live release-identity expectations.

findings.title: Development Compose hot reload command is ignored by the entrypoint
findings.behavior_correction: Honor explicit container command overrides after the migration gate.

findings.title: Make crash-proof wrapper migrates before isolation checks
findings.behavior_correction: Run crash-proof isolation guards before any database operation; Make no longer migrates first.

findings.title: Rotation verification transmits bootstrap keys over remote HTTP
findings.behavior_correction: Validate rotation-verifier origins before sending keys and refuse redirects/remote plaintext HTTP.

findings.title: Partner bootstrap ignores successful --key-only output mode
findings.behavior_correction: Emit only the minted key plus newline for successful --key-only bootstrap output.

findings.title: Load battery stops a container it did not create
findings.behavior_correction: Stop only containers created by the load script itself, including failed-readiness cleanup.

findings.title: Load battery labels an all-error run PASS and exits zero
findings.behavior_correction: Require complete successful workload and no error/denial/accounting anomaly for load PASS and zero exit.

findings.title: Loaded claim manifest promotes a PASS summary over FAIL/ERROR rows
findings.behavior_correction: Preserve negative FAIL/ERROR observations when loading manifests rather than trusting a contradictory PASS summary.

findings.title: Repo guardian caches failed full lint as a successful sweep
findings.behavior_correction: Cache guardian full sweeps only when both tests and lint succeed; invalidate older cached success after a forced failure.

findings.title: Live stress checks accept HTTP failures and absent receipt IDs
findings.behavior_correction: Require successful HTTP/JSON-RPC responses and nonblank receipt IDs from every stress result; use identical same-key payloads and checks that survive -O.

findings.title: Adversarial battery forwards API keys across redirect origins
findings.behavior_correction: Refuse redirects for authenticated adversarial requests so credentials and mutations stay at the chosen destination.

findings.title: Comparison report interprets configuration errors as successful measurements
findings.behavior_correction: Exclude ERROR configuration counters from prevention/latency arithmetic while rendering errors and retaining valid partial baseline comparisons.

findings.title: Diagnostic request size limit applies only after full buffering
findings.behavior_correction: Enforce the diagnostic body limit while consuming ASGI chunks, including absent/false Content-Length.

findings.title: Agent-facing documentation advertises a nonexistent rate-limit burst
findings.behavior_correction: Document the configurable default 120/min, zero extra burst and fixed Redis versus rolling local windows.

findings.title: Agent endpoint table labels production discovery authentication optional
findings.behavior_correction: Document production-like discovery authentication and anonymous local-compatible quickstart accurately.

findings.title: Troubleshooting treats an uncertain-delivery receipt as proof of acceptance
findings.behavior_correction: Explain that delivery_uncertain proves neither acceptance nor execution and requires authoritative downstream reconciliation.

findings.title: Rehydrate durable AI decisions and heals before exposing them through typed routes
findings.behavior_correction: Rehydrate durable decision/heal records and timestamps and initialize read routes after restart.

findings.title: Use the configured API root once when building OpenAI chat URLs
findings.behavior_correction: Treat the configured OpenAI URL as the API root and append the chat path only once.

findings.title: Propagate structured DOM execution failure to AWI top-level status before accounting
findings.behavior_correction: Propagate structured browser failure as uncertain effect status and truthful governed accounting; preserve precharge/owner semantics from SEC-008.

findings.title: Prevent browser dispatch when AWI callers explicitly request a dry run
findings.behavior_correction: Reject unsupported dry run without browser commands or step mutation; final AWI precharge is refunded only on trusted not-dispatched evidence.

findings.title: Bind all effect-bearing AWI arguments into the idempotency identity
findings.behavior_correction: Bind all normalized effect-bearing arguments plus wallet/tool/permit to AWI request identity; changed same-key semantics conflict.

findings.title: Enforce signed AWI argument prohibitions and atomic per-tool call limits before execution
findings.behavior_correction: Enforce signed forbidden-field constraints and refuse unsupported per-tool call-limit authority before callbacks.

findings.title: Honor write-only and explicit-deny IoT topic ACLs
findings.behavior_correction: Enforce READ/WRITE direction and precedence of every matching IoT DENY rule.
findings.independent_review_scope_note: Linked interim independent review concerns later integration repairs; it does not claim independent rereading of these earlier fix commits. Original owner tests and combined integration checks remain distinct.

findings.title: Persist completed content campaigns and their pipeline links
findings.behavior_correction: Persist campaign pipeline links and terminal status, including failed render state, across restart.
findings.independent_review_scope_note: Linked interim independent review concerns later integration repairs; it does not claim independent rereading of these earlier fix commits. Original owner tests and combined integration checks remain distinct.

findings.title: Generate valid Python literals in the behavioral sandbox wrapper
findings.behavior_correction: Generate valid Python values in behavioral runner wrappers while preserving captured output.

findings.title: Validate RTaaS attack categories at the request boundary
findings.behavior_correction: Validate RTaaS attack category values at the request boundary and return 422 before engine execution.

findings.title: Remove live security-testing and CI-gate claims from simulated scan route metadata
findings.behavior_correction: Describe simulated security-scan behavior accurately in route metadata while keeping execution gates.

findings.title: Delete every memory before removing the AWI session index
findings.behavior_correction: Iterate a snapshot of session memory IDs so deletion removes every owned record without skipping mutated-index entries.

findings.title: Reject or safely handle empty AWI RAG queries
findings.behavior_correction: Reject blank RAG queries at the HTTP schema boundary and safely return no results for direct empty search without embedding/access mutations.

findings.title: Do not report malformed or failed Python runner output as success
findings.behavior_correction: Reject malformed, nonobject or failed Python runner output and process errors instead of reporting success.

findings.title: Standalone MCP generator emits Python that cannot start
findings.behavior_correction: Retire the server standalone generator with explicit refusal before registry traversal or output writes; retain callable argument compatibility and active metadata generation.

findings.title: A valid no-argument local tool breaks standard MCP discovery
findings.behavior_correction: Normalize absent/null no-argument tool schemas to an object schema for standard MCP discovery, preserving explicit schemas.

findings.title: SDK local permit verification rejects valid action-bound permits
findings.behavior_correction: Include all six signed action-binding fields in SDK canonical permit verification; preserve legacy envelope bytes.

findings.title: Framework wrapper retry changes permit body after a lost creation response
findings.behavior_correction: Retain the original permit issuance body before the first await in framework wrappers, including expiry, across ambiguous same-key retries.

findings.title: Legacy SDK standalone MCP command and generated scripts are unusable
findings.behavior_correction: Retire standalone SDK generation with explicit refusal before tool discovery or output writes; accept existing CLI/callable arguments and return controlled CLI exit 2.

findings.title: Legacy framework client omits current discovery authentication and AWI governance inputs
findings.behavior_correction: Forward credentials for discovery and require caller-owned AWI permit/idempotency arguments.

findings.title: AWI discovery still denies permit enforcement on governed HTTP routes
findings.behavior_correction: Advertise the six actual governed AWI HTTP routes and their permit requirements accurately.

findings.title: Public site and bootstrap manifests claim private source repository is public
findings.behavior_correction: Describe private source access separately from publicly downloadable proof artifacts.

findings.title: Agent self-credentialing guide writes unevaluated shell substitution into dotenv signing key
findings.behavior_correction: Generate the local signing seed in the invoking shell rather than storing unevaluated shell substitution in dotenv.

findings.title: Key Rotation can consume multiple lives in one update despite granting invulnerability
findings.behavior_correction: Honor collision invulnerability inside each sweeper iteration; one update cannot deduct multiple lives after respawn. Bust cached script references so deployed clients receive the corrected arcade code.

findings.title: Happy Path draws the player twelve pixels above its collision position
findings.behavior_correction: Align the rendered player body with its ground/platform collision origin. Bust cached script references so deployed clients receive the corrected arcade code.

findings.title: Tap Forge discards passive quota earnings on every animation frame
findings.behavior_correction: Carry fractional passive quota earnings across animation frames and clear the carry on reset. Bust cached script references so deployed clients receive the corrected arcade code.

findings.title: Security reviewer claim omits local invocations that cannot produce a receipt
findings.behavior_correction: Qualify receipt guarantees for terminalized/reconciled paths and identify local crashes requiring manual review without a receipt.

findings.title: Golden-path dogfood substitution leaves incompatible message arguments
findings.behavior_correction: Use the dogfood tool text argument for both first invocation and replay.

findings.title: Partner offline-verification install command omits required verify extra
findings.behavior_correction: Install the SDK verify extra for source and wheel offline-verifier recipes.

findings.title: CI bootstrap recipe combines credentials from three separate provisioning runs
findings.behavior_correction: Extract API key, wallet and key ID from one provisioning response.

findings.title: Legacy database guidance recommends stamping current head without schema equivalence
findings.behavior_correction: Require physical schema/data-history review for unstamped existing databases; stamp only a proven matching historical revision.

findings.title: Lockdown and key-rotation runbooks retain deployment paths contradicted by current immutable release SOP
findings.behavior_correction: Use qualified exact-SHA release contexts and schema-compatible recovery in lockdown/key-rotation runbooks.

findings.title: Local demo Compose recipe omits DATABASE_URL required for its key and trust workflow
findings.behavior_correction: Replace the broken local Compose example with the supported persistent SQLite/signing-seed quickstart.

findings.title: Historical external diagnostic harness reports zero findings for unauthenticated200 responses
findings.behavior_correction: Retire historical gauntlet CLI and raw transport with explicit refusal; preserve archived raw output and label counts non-gating.

findings.title: Partner checklist uses GET for the POST-only receipt verification operation
findings.behavior_correction: Use authenticated POST with receipt_id for receipt verification.

findings.title: Failure-lab suite quick commands select the older lab instead of the advertised fast tier
findings.behavior_correction: Point the advertised fast-tier Failure Lab command to the actual suite target.

findings.title: Refresh widens an attenuated JWT scope set
findings.behavior_correction: Preserve attenuated or empty JWT scopes across refresh and reject unbound/malformed refresh authority.

findings.title: Scoped access tokens can mint unrestricted wallet API keys
findings.behavior_correction: Reject JWT callers that attempt to mint or replace unrestricted persistent API credentials.

findings.title: Derived JWT authentication bypasses the originating key use budget
findings.behavior_correction: Atomically consume the originating live key use budget when authenticating derived JWTs.

findings.title: Bearer callers choose fresh rate buckets with ignored API-key headers
findings.behavior_correction: Select rate buckets from the accepted authentication path, ignoring spoofed unused key headers and stabilizing JWT rotation identity.

findings.title: Readiness probe returns healthy HTTP status during dependency failure
findings.behavior_correction: Probe required ORM and durable-state dependencies with bounded waits; return HTTP 503 when unavailable.

findings.title: Late IGA compensation erases a different invocation velocity reservation
findings.behavior_correction: Compensate the exact identity-bearing IGA velocity reservation once; never remove a newer invocation reservation.

findings.title: Concurrent valid append makes audit verification falsely report truncation
findings.behavior_correction: Read audit head and bounded event stream from one SQL statement snapshot, retaining real truncation detection.

findings.title: AWI performs effects before budget/debit and repeats them after reservation contention
findings.behavior_correction: Reserve permit authority and checkpoint an operation-key debit before any of six AWI callbacks. Preserve owners across ambiguous errors/process death; refund only proven non-dispatch, and replay receipts without redispatch.

findings.title: SQLite permit issuance signs values that change during persistence
findings.behavior_correction: Reject permit max_credits/aggregate caps that cannot survive exact storage before signing; preserve the numeric bounds in generated schemas.
